advice.extremeHeat: 🔥 **Heat Advisory** — Stay hydrated, avoid prolonged sun exposure. Light, breathable clothing recommended. Air conditioning advised for vulnerable populations.
advice.hotDay: ☀️ **Sunny & Dry** — High dehydration risk. Carry water, wear sunscreen SPF 30+, seek shade during peak hours (11:00–15:00).
advice.warmPleasant: 🌤️ **Pleasant Conditions** — Ideal for outdoor activities. Light clothing sufficient. UV protection still recommended during midday.
advice.mild: ⛅ **Mild Weather** — Comfortable temperatures. Layered clothing advised for variable conditions. Good for extended outdoor activities.
advice.cool: 🍃 **Cool Temperatures** — A jacket or sweater recommended. Good conditions for jogging and outdoor exercise.
advice.cold: ❄️ **Cold Advisory** — Dress warmly: coat, gloves, scarf. Limit exposed skin time. Watch for wind chill effects.
advice.freezing: 🥶 **Extreme Cold Warning** — Dangerous conditions. Multiple layers essential. Limit outdoor exposure. Check on elderly and pets.
advice.rainy: 🌧️ **Rain Expected** — Carry an umbrella or waterproof jacket. Roads may be slippery. Reduced visibility: drive carefully.
advice.stormy: ⛈️ **Thunderstorm Risk** — Seek shelter indoors. Avoid open areas, tall trees, and bodies of water. Postpone outdoor activities.
advice.foggy: 🌫️ **Low Visibility** — Fog conditions. Reduce driving speed, use low-beam headlights. Allow extra travel time.
advice.windy: 💨 **High Winds** — Secure loose outdoor objects. Difficult conditions for cycling. Watch for flying debris.
advice.perfect: ✨ **Perfect Conditions** — Temperature, humidity, and wind are all in optimal ranges. An exceptional day to be outside!
advice.uvHigh: ⚠️ **High UV Index** — Sunburn risk in 15-25 minutes. Broad-spectrum sunscreen, sunglasses, and hat essential between 10:00–16:00.
advice.uvExtreme: 🚨 **Extreme UV** — Sunburn in 10 minutes. Minimize sun exposure, full protective gear required.
advice.aqiBad: 😷 **Poor Air Quality** — Sensitive groups should limit outdoor exertion. Consider mask in heavily polluted areas. Keep windows closed.
